description: Capability for the main window. App-defined commands (send_core_command) are always invokable and need no explicit permission entry; this grants the baseline window/core APIs Tauri itself needs plus the plugin permissions actually called from the frontend -- notification:default for Phase 4.5's toast notifications (sendNotification/requestPermission/isPermissionGranted are called directly from React, unlike tray-icon/global-shortcut/clipboard-manager, which are only ever driven from the Rust side).
